messages:
Sasha: Heads up — spotted a permission rollback for role 'svc-data-analyst' in the audit stream, but the audit_event.actor is NULL. happened right after the role-refactor merge.
Jamie: Ugh. Do we have the event id or request id?
Sasha: event_id=evt_20260318_0312_7f3a, request_id=req-9b2c. audit row exists but actor column is empty, action=role.update, prev_roles=[data_read], new_roles=[data_read, analytics_read].
Morgan: Was that change applied by the reconciler or by a human PR merge? I remember the refactor touched the reconciler's apply path.
Sasha: PR that merged: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/perm-reconciler/pull/412 — it added a fallback system principal for service applies.
Evan: If reconciler used a system principal that isn't mapped to a user, we might be writing NULL actor. We should check the reconciler logs around 03:12 UTC for "applied patch" messages.
Jamie: Querying audit DB now:
```
SELECT id, action, actor, metadata->>'request_id' AS req FROM audit_events WHERE request_id='req-9b2c';
```
Sasha: Also check KMS access logs — there was a KMS key rotation window early morning. If the reconciler refreshed creds and used instance identity, actor could be blank.
deploy-bot: deploy event: perm-reconciler v1.8.3 deployed by ci-bot at 2026-03-18T02:45:10Z
Morgan: Can someone paste reconciler logs around that request id? I suspect the reconciler is calling the audit API without setting the actor header when running as internal-system.
Evan: grabbed logs, snippet:
```
2026-03-18T03:12:05Z reconciler apply START req=req-9b2c
2026-03-18T03:12:06Z reconciler audit POST /v1/audit - body:{"action":"role.update","role":"svc-data-analyst","actor":null}
2026-03-18T03:12:07Z reconciler apply COMPLETE req=req-9b2c
```
Jamie: yep actor=null in audit payload. that's a bug in reconciler where it should inject service account id `system:reconciler`.
Sasha: For compliance, we need to backfill who approved the change in git and flag this as an audit gap. Can we reconstruct actor from the reconciler run metadata? The reconciler run links to PR/commit.
Morgan: reconciler run metadata includes commit sha and triggering PR in the job context. Use that to set actor=ci-bot/<commit-author> for backfill.
Evan: I'll run a backfill script to update audit_events.actor for events with null actor and a reconciler request_id. Proposed query:
```
UPDATE audit_events a
SET actor = r.triggering_actor
FROM reconciler_runs r
WHERE a.request_id = r.request_id AND a.actor IS NULL;
```
Jamie: +1 but record the backfill as a separate audit_event so it's clear we changed historical data (compliance requirement).
Sasha: Also we need an immediate patch to reconciler to always set X-Actor header. Create a hotfix PR and release to Dedicated and Private.
Morgan: Filed issue and draft PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/perm-reconciler/pull/418 — adds actor injection and test coverage.
Evan: I'll run the backfill now in staging and then prod after signoff. I'll also run a verification query to ensure no remaining null actors for role.* events in the window 03:00-04:00 UTC.
Sasha: Can Security own the compliance report note? We need a description: cause, scope (number of affected events), mitigation, and long-term fix.
Jamie: I can take the report. I'll need counts — Evan, paste numbers when backfill completes.
auditor-bot: Alert generated: audit-gap-detected -> 7 events with NULL actor for role.update between 2026-03-18T03:00:00Z and 2026-03-18T03:15:00Z
Evan: Backfill ran in staging, patched reconciler in canary. Prod backfill queued after DB maintenance window at 04:30 UTC.
Morgan: Postmortem items: 1) reconciler must set actor header; 2) audit API should reject writes with null actor unless caller is a trusted system, in which case it must provide a system principal; 3) add monitor for audit_event.actor IS NULL for sensitive actions.
Sasha: Agreed. Also add an entry for SOC2 binder: ticket link to PR and backfill notes.
Jamie: I'll attach the SQL queries, reconciler logs, PR links, and the auditor-bot alert to the report. ETA for final report: EOD today.
Evan: Prod backfill ran at 04:32 UTC. Updated 7 rows; inserted 1 audit_event documenting the backfill (actor=security-team).
Sasha: Thanks all. After the patch rollouts, let's schedule a tabletop for permission-refactor failure modes next week.
Morgan: noted, adding to eng-security calendar.
Jamie: closing loop here — report uploaded to /compliance/soc2/2026-03-audit-gap.pdf
Sasha: :thumbsup:
